# PngSuite

The 176 PNG files here are PngSuite by Willem van Schaik, version 2017jul19, from http://www.schaik.com/pngsuite/PngSuite-2017jul19.tgz.
Permission to use, copy, modify and distribute them for any purpose and without fee is granted: see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

`chromium.json` is ours: the SHA-256 of what Chromium's own decoder gives for each file, and the 14 corrupt files it refuses.
